items.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: INTERVIEWER: ...Trumpets; Wendell Cully, Snooky Young, Thad Jones, Joe Newman... Trombones; Henry Coker... And we‘re going to pick up with the tail end of the Count Basie time, that you‘re with Count Basie the second time.

ctx.x: Butch Miles is white, what made me think he wasn‘t it, I remember Butch Miles.
Maybe you‘re thinking of Buddy Miles. [laughs] …
